ledger.summary: Ralph rereads the book: it does not say where the woman came from, why she returned to the wood and endured thraldom, where the lonely place is, or the road to the Well. He hopes she will love him and lead him to the Well. He notes that men praise her while women fear or hate her. Over three days he ventures into the wood (further south), panics and runs back, waits restlessly; the carline visits her brother among the brethren of the Thorn and then urges him to try the wood again.
ledger.geography_notes: Ralph enters the wood further south than before. The brethren of the Thorn are "over yonder", within a day's return trip of the castle.
open_questions: Is the Thorn house within a day's walk of the castle?
